sections.title: Joshua's Farewell Address
observations: In this chapter, Joshua, now old and advanced in years, gathers the leaders of Israel to remind them of God's faithfulness and the importance of remaining obedient to His commands.
He emphasizes the need for the Israelites to remember the victories God has given them and to continue to follow the Law of Moses, which is crucial for their continued success in the land.

sections.title: Warning Against Apostasy
observations: Joshua warns the people against intermingling with the remaining nations and adopting their practices, which could lead them away from God.
He stresses that failure to drive out these nations will result in them becoming snares and traps for Israel, leading to spiritual and moral decline.

sections.title: The Certainty of God's Promises
observations: Joshua reassures the Israelites that God will fulfill His promises, just as He has done in the past.
He encourages them to be strong and courageous, reminding them that God will fight for them as long as they remain faithful.

importantVerses.commentary: Be very strong; be careful to obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, without turning aside to the right or to the left.
You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the Lord your God gave you has failed.

questions: What does Joshua's farewell address teach us about leadership and legacy?
How can we apply the warning against apostasy in our own lives today?
In what ways can we remind ourselves of God's past faithfulness to strengthen our faith for the future?
